name: Swadeshi Polytex Limited
about: Swadeshi Polytex Limited engages in the real estate development and allied business activities in India. The company engages in acquisition, development, leasing, renting, sub-leasing, and sale and management of land, plots, buildings, warehouses, industrial, commercial and residential properties, and other immovable assets. It also offers related real estate activities in the capacity of developer, advisor, broker, agent, and service provider. Swadeshi Polytex Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Ghaziabad, India.
